The travelling merchant shop is an area in the lobby, near the [[Summon|summoning]] area where people can acquire [[items]]. After the timer runs out (60 mins), the shop is closed and a sign is left asking to check back later. After a further 30 minutes, the shop returns with up to 3 new items, which the player can buy with either gems or coins.
